# Coolmic fixtures

`title-page.html` preserves metadata and the bootstrap element from [Love Me! P.S. I'm Awesome](https://coolmic.me/titles/5101), captured on 2026-10-25. Its bootstrap contains the 53-episode public catalog and the fields consumed by the integration, with an anonymous user state.

`contract.json` contains the viewer vector with all 31 page records. Access credentials are synthetic, and deterministic browser image responses contain controlled PNG data. These inputs exercise accessible and locked episodes, page order, cancellation, and protocol failures.
